# Shivansh Fulper — Portfolio

> Founder and AI systems engineer building Waldo and Kennel.

## About

Shivansh Fulper builds the context, tools, permissions, memory, and evaluation systems that make AI agents useful once people rely on them. He completed a B.Tech in Smart Manufacturing at IIITDM Jabalpur in 2026.

He is now building Waldo, a user-owned personal agent that stays on the person's side across models, tools, work, life, and eventually physical devices. Kennel is Waldo's first home on the Mac: a place to see what finished, what needs judgment, and what remains open.

Previously, Shivansh helped build and operate more than 30 production agent instances through AtlanClaw at Atlan. He also contributed to [Project EKA](https://soket.ai/project-eka) and built LLM pre-training infrastructure at Soket AI Labs, built an NLP-to-workflow system through Code for GovTech, created developer prototypes at Ionio AI, implemented Qwen3 MoE from scratch, co-founded EcoFresh Greensync, grew [HackByte](https://www.hackbyte.in/) from an internal college event to 5,154 registrations as a lead organiser across three years, and was selected among 40 Indian students for the 2025 MIRAI-Setu exchange by Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

## Ventures

- [Waldo](https://shivanshfulper.com/work/waldo): A user-owned personal agent for continuity across models, tools, work, and life. Kennel is its first Mac home. Core insight: an agent finishing a task and the task actually being done are two different things.
- [EcoFresh Greensync](https://shivanshfulper.com/work/ecofresh): Decentralized waste-to-value infrastructure for processing mixed municipal waste into recoverable outputs.

## Current focus

Physical AI, Industry 4.0, Quantum + AI, personal agents, human-agent orchestration, outcome verification, durable agent infrastructure, and user-owned context and permissions.
